reference_solution:
class ListNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
        self.val = val
        self.next = next

def build(values):
    dummy = ListNode()
    cur = dummy
    for v in values:
        cur.next = ListNode(v)
        cur = cur.next
    return dummy.next

def to_list(head):
    out = []
    while head:
        out.append(head.val)
        head = head.next
    return out

def is_palindrome_list(values):
    head = build(values)
    if not head or not head.next:
        return True
    slow = head
    fast = head
    while fast and fast.next:
        slow = slow.next
        fast = fast.next.next
    prev = None
    curr = slow
    while curr:
        nxt = curr.next
        curr.next = prev
        prev = curr
        curr = nxt
    left = head
    right = prev
    while right:
        if left.val != right.val:
            return False
        left = left.next
        right = right.next
    return True
